source:
@@U04657@@
Will-o’-the-wisps, away!
Ah, you shine so brightly till Pve caught you,
and then you're a sticky mess
Away, I say! Now!
Ah, there’s something like pitch and sulfur
nipping at my neck!
translation:
@@U04657@@
鬼火，走开！
啊，你是如此耀眼，直到 Pve 抓住你，
然后你就变成一团粘糊糊的烂摊子
走开，我说！现在！
啊，有沥青和硫磺之类的东西
咬我脖子！
